step1_analysis.description: A precharge-evaluate dynamic latch (sense amplifier) commonly used in high-speed prescalers or phase-frequency detectors in PLLs. It precharges the differential outputs (Q/QB) to VDD when CLK is low, and evaluates the differential inputs (D/DB) when CLK goes high, using a cross-coupled NMOS pair for fast switching.

paper_reference.title: A 1.5-V 900-MHz Monolithic CMOS Fast-Switching Frequency Synthesizer for Wireless Applications

delay_clk_q.description: Delay from CLK rising edge to Q/QB falling edge during the evaluation phase.

sky130_expected.calculation: Estimated load capacitance C_load ~ 20fF. NMOS drive current I_on ~ 0.5 * 270uA/V^2 * 10 * (1.8V - 0.42V)^2 ~ 2.5mA. Delay ~ C*V/I = 20fF * 0.9V / 2.5mA = 7.2ps. Adding parasitics and cross-coupled contention, expect 20-50ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS drive strength and estimated parasitic capacitance for W=5u L=0.5u.

power.description: Average power consumption of the latch operating at 900 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = C * V^2 * f. For two nodes with 20fF each at 900MHz: P = 40fF * (1.8V)^2 * 900MHz = 116uW. Adding short-circuit power during evaluation gives ~200uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard dynamic power formula C*V^2*f at the target frequency of 900 MHz.

voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the output nodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: Outputs are precharged to VDD by PMOS and pulled to GND by NMOS.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic latches typically achieve full rail-to-rail swing if given enough evaluation time.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis at 900 MHz to measure CLK-to-Q delay, voltage swing, and average power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dynamic Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* CLK at 900 MHz (1.111ns period)
VCLK CLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 20p 20p 500p 1.111n)
* D and DB toggle at 450 MHz to test both states
VD D 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 20p 20p 1.111n 2.222n)
VDB DB 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 20p 20p 1.111n 2.222n)

XM1 Q DB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 QB Q GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 QB D GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 Q QB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 Q CLK VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 QB CLK VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Load capacitance
C1 Q 0 10f
C2 QB 0 10f

.control
tran 5p 5n
* Measure delay for QB falling (first evaluation cycle)
meas tran delay_clk_qb_fall trig v(clk) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(qb) val=0.9 fall=1
* Measure delay for Q falling (second evaluation cycle)
meas tran delay_clk_q_fall trig v(clk) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(q) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure voltage swing
meas tran v_max max v(q)
meas tran v_min min v(q)
let swing = v_max - v_min
print swing

* Measure average power
meas tran i_avg avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=5n
let pwr = -i_avg * 1.8
print pwr

quit
.endc
